candidates.change_summary: Replace the condition `msg.value >= MinDeposit` with `msg.value > MinDeposit` so that exactly 1 ether deposits are rejected, changing which deposits update balances.
Delete the require statement that checks for overflow, allowing the balance to be updated even if an overflow occurs, which changes the final balance in such a case.
Replace `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value` with `balances[msg.sender] = msg.value` so that the balance is overwritten rather than incremented.
Insert `balances[msg.sender] = 0;` before the balance increment so that previous balance is erased, changing the final balance.
Remove the if condition guard entirely so that every call with any msg.value updates the balance.
Replace `require(((balances[msg.sender] + msg.value) >= balances[msg.sender]));` with `require(false);` so that Deposit always reverts and balances never change.
Delete the entire if-body (the three statements inside the if block) so that Deposit() never updates balances.
Replace `msg.sender` with `address(0)` in the balance key so that Deposit updates a different account's balance.
Changed the CashOut balance check from <= to <, so CashOut of exactly the full balance becomes a no-op.
Changed the subtraction in the CashOut state update to addition, so a successful CashOut increases the caller's balance instead of decreasing it.
Moved the balance-decrement state update to after the external call, so the caller's balance is still unchanged during the call and can be observed/reentered.
Changed the success-condition check to use the raw call success flag inverted, so on a successful call the balance decrement is skipped and the function reverts only when the call itself succeeded.
Change the CashOut guard from `_am <= balances[msg.sender]` to `_am < balances[msg.sender]`, making CashOut revert when withdrawing exactly the caller's full balance.
Move the balance decrement to after the external call, so the callee re-enters with the pre-withdrawal balance still recorded.
Delete the balance decrement statement, so CashOut sends the requested amount while leaving the recorded balance unchanged.
Delete the success branch so CashOut never logs the CashOut message to TransferLog.
Delete the TransferLog.AddMessage call inside the success branch, so successful CashOuts are not recorded on-chain.
Move the TransferLog.AddMessage logging call to before the external value transfer, changing what the log observes relative to the call.
